follow-up time: From primary cesarean delivery to subsequent TOLAC attempt
outcome: Uterine rupture during trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: Women attempting TOLAC in a single, tertiary, university-affiliated medical center between 2007 and 2016
finding: Postpartum hemorrhage and infection during a primary cesarean delivery are associated with an increased risk of uterine rupture during a subsequent TOLAC attempt.
mod_finding: This study found that postpartum hemorrhage and infection after a primary cesarean delivery were associated with increased risk for uterine rupture during a subsequent trial of labor after cesarean.
